entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Query: whole non-entity object from a plain (non-aggregated) LeftJoin/DefaultIfEmpty inner is not nulled on no-match #38608

Closed

  • Json and ComplexProperty and nested collection exception : Complex entry original ordinal ''-1'' is invalid for property ... as it''s outside of the collection of length ''0''. #38566
  • Add-Migration does not work with MSIX project #38572
  • Custom migration operations #38600
  • Is there a way to open a sqlite database FROM memory (not INTO memory)? #38561
  • Translate int.Parse and similar #28287
    11.0.0
  • DatabaseFacade.HasPendingModelChanges() false-positives on SQL Server temporal tables (PeriodStart/PeriodEnd) that the CLI correctly reports as clean #38602
  • StateManager.ChangeCount becomes -1 after detaching entity — breaks HasChanges() #36179
  • NullReferenceException from ChangeTracker when using HasDiscriminator() #38096
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Update SQLitePCLRaw package versions #38607
  • [release/9.0] Update SQLitePCLRaw package versions #38606
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/8.0] Update SQLitePCLRaw package versions #38605
    Servicing-consider

Merged

  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38609
  • SqlServer: Translate x.Parse #28337
    community-contribution

Updated

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #38604
  • Warn and fix identity conflict when owned entity has inconsistent data in DB #38596
  • Cosmos: run query response status checks inside execution strategy retries #38591
  • Adjust migration operation ordering to avoid dropping in-use sequences during TPC sequence transitions #38583
  • Handle seed-data cycle diagnostics without crashing during migration scaffolding #38589
  • Cosmos: flow transactional batch failures through the execution strategy so they can be retried #38597
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0' => 'release/9.0' #38531
  • [release/11.0-preview6] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38580
  • Fix Remove-Migration snapshot corruption for owned one-to-one relationships #38588
